query: SELECT tp.id, tp.dentistId, d.name as dentist_name, tp.procedureId, p.name as procedure_name, tp.price, tp.createdAt FROM treatment_procedures tp LEFT JOIN dentists d ON tp.dentistId = d.id LEFT JOIN procedures p ON tp.procedureId = p.id ORDER BY tp.createdAt DESC LIMIT 20;
